summary: Independently re-verified the expanded /startup-market deck. Navigated all 27 slides via Далее (and re-validated 13-17 + 27 via dot nav). No blank slides, zero vertical overflow on any slide at 1920x800. Slides 13/14/15/16/17 each render a 3-column data table (CSS-grid based) with colored header row and 4-6 body rows of readable text. Chart slides (6,7,8,9,10,11,19,24) are two-column with text + corresponding VIS-XX.svg image. Slide 27 now uses the LIGHT cream palette rgb(247,245,239) matching the rest of the deck, contains the 'Главное практическое следствие' callout box, and Next is correctly disabled. PDF button enables within ~25s, opens menu with light/dark options, both produce valid blob: URLs; the light blob is a valid %PDF (4.82MB) with /Count 27 and 27 /Type /Page entries.
critical_code_review_comments: SMTableC renders the 3-col 'table' with CSS Grid divs rather than a semantic <table>. Functional and accessible enough for a slide deck, but semantic HTML <table>/<thead>/<tbody> would improve a11y and screen-reader navigation.
Per-slide data-testid is only present on slides 1 and 27. Adding sm-slide-{N} on all 27 wrappers would simplify future regression testing (current workaround is sm-dot-{0..26}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tables on slides 13-17 are CSS-grid based (divs with class 'rounded-md' wrapping grid children), NOT HTML <table>. To detect them, query 'div.rounded-md' > 'div.grid' and inspect children.length for column count. Header bg colors vary by section: navy rgb(27,58,91) on 13/14, orange rgb(181,97,42) on 15/17, green rgb(46,110,90) on 16. Slide 27 inner background confirmed rgb(247,245,239) cream (matches rest of deck). PDF generation completes within ~25s; light blob ~4.8MB with /Count 27.
